title: MedFact: Benchmarking the Fact-Checking Capabilities of Large Language Models on Chinese Medical Texts

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the models' ability to detect and localize 'Biased Content Errors' (defined as content perpetuating stereotypes related to social identity or employing prejudiced language in medical diagnoses and recommendations) through Veracity Classification (VC) and Error Localization (EL) tasks.

Measuring the models' tendency to excessively flag factually correct medical information as erroneous (high false positive rate), particularly analyzing how this algorithmic bias is exacerbated by advanced reasoning techniques like retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), multi-agent collaboration, and inference-time compute scaling.
